context:
Goal: banchi works on your phone.
Problem (risk): a switch turns off every banchi screen test narrower than 768 px, so phone widths (390 and 720 px) are never checked, and banchi's own debt record says a sideways scroll at 390 px would reach your phone.
Based on (measured): banchi app/tests/phoneSwitch.ts line 12 sets the switch off.
Based on (ruling): your earlier ruling, recorded in that banchi debt, to keep them off.
Departs from: main (phone-size tests off) — turns them on in banchi's automatic checks.
home: docs/plans/test-ci-standard.md on branch claude/test-ci-standard (banchi phone lane dropped)

lastAnswer.note: Banchi is used on a desktop primarily -- what made yu think it's used mainly on a phone?

options.gain: Phone layouts are proven before they ship.
options.how: The tests run again; a lane fixes whatever goes red.
options.label: Turn them on and fix what fails
options.lose: One fix lane, and a longer screen check.

options.label: Keep them off
options.lose: A broken phone layout can ship with green checks.

reply: Wrong guess, now dropped: the lane read banchi debt DEBT77 ("a sideways scroll at 390 would reach his phone") as phone use. The banchi phone lane is out of the plan.
title: Should banchi's phone-size screen tests run again?
why: Your phone is where banchi is used.
